translations.literal: The government army could not form ranks in time and was utterly defeated; officers and soldiers died by weapons and drowning in the Huai; only several hundred escaped; weapons, supplies, grain, horses, and carts lost numbered in the tens of thousands; the rebels displayed Keshi's head and those of the army supervisor and generals at Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: The government army could not form in time and was utterly defeated. Men died by weapons and drowning; only several hundred escaped. Lost weapons, grain, horses, and carts numbered in the tens of thousands. The rebels displayed Keshi's head and those of the supervisor and generals at Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 龐勳自謂無敵於天下，作露布，散示諸寨及鄉村，於是淮南士民震恐，往往避地江左。

translations.literal: Pang Xun considered himself matchless under heaven and composed a battlefield proclamation, spreading it through the camps and villages; then the gentry and commoners of Huainan were shaken with terror and often fled to the lands east of the river.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Xun deemed himself matchless under heaven, composed a proclamation, and spread it through camps and villages. Huainan gentry and commoners were terrified and often fled east of the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 令狐綯畏其侵軼，遣使詣勳說諭，許為奏請節鉞。

translations.literal: Linghu Tao, fearing invasion, sent an envoy to Pang Xun to persuade him and promised to memorialize requesting a military commission for him.
translations.idiomatic: Linghu Tao, fearing invasion, sent an envoy to persuade Pang Xun and promised to memorialize requesting a commission for him.

sentences.zh: 勳乃息兵俟命。

translations.literal: Xun then ceased military action and awaited orders.
translations.idiomatic: Xun then ceased fighting and awaited orders.

sentences.zh: 由是淮南稍得收散卒，修守備。。

translations.literal: Thereby Huainan was able somewhat to gather scattered troops and repair defenses.
translations.idiomatic: Thereby Huainan was able somewhat to gather scattered troops and repair defenses.

sentences.zh: 時汴路既絕，江、淮往來者皆出壽州，賊既破戴可師，乘勝圍壽州，掠諸道貢獻及商人貨，其路復絕。

translations.literal: At that time the Bian route was already cut off; those traveling between Jiang and Huai all went by Shouzhou; after the rebels defeated Dai Keshi they took advantage of the victory to besiege Shouzhou, plundering tribute from the various circuits and merchants' goods, and the route was cut off again.
translations.idiomatic: The Bian route was cut off; Jiang-Huai traffic went by Shouzhou. After defeating Dai Keshi the rebels besieged Shouzhou, plundered tribute and merchants' goods, and cut the route again.

sentences.zh: 勳益自驕，日事游宴。

translations.literal: Xun grew ever more arrogant and daily devoted himself to tours and feasts.
translations.idiomatic: Xun grew ever more arrogant and daily devoted himself to tours and feasts.

sentences.zh: 周重諫曰：「自古驕滿奢逸，得而復失，成而覆敗，多矣，況未得未成而為之者乎！」。

translations.literal: Zhou Chong remonstrated, saying, "Since antiquity pride, fullness, luxury, and dissipation—gaining and then losing, succeeding and then overturning—have been many; how much more for one who has not yet gained and not yet succeeded!"
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Chong remonstrated: "Since antiquity pride, luxury, and dissipation—gain then lose, succeed then fail—have been countless; how much more for one who has not yet gained or succeeded!"

sentences.zh: 諸道兵大集於宋州，徐州始懼，應募者益少，而諸塞求益兵者相繼。

translations.literal: Troops from the various circuits massed at Songzhou; Xu Prefecture at last grew fearful, and those answering the recruitment call grew ever fewer, while the various strongpoints asked for more troops in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Troops from all circuits massed at Songzhou. Xu Prefecture at last grew fearful; recruits grew fewer while outposts asked for reinforcements in succession.

sentences.zh: 勳乃使其黨散入鄉村，驅人為兵。

translations.literal: Xun then sent his partisans scattered into villages to drive the people into the army.
translations.idiomatic: Xun sent his partisans into villages to drive people into the army.

sentences.zh: 又見兵已及數萬人，資糧匱竭，乃斂富室及商旅財，什取其七八，坐匿財夷宗者數百家。

translations.literal: Seeing that troops already numbered tens of thousands and supplies were exhausted, he then levied the wealth of rich households and traveling merchants, taking seven or eight tenths of each; several hundred families who concealed wealth had their clans exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: With troops already in the tens of thousands and supplies exhausted, he levied rich households and merchants, taking seven or eight tenths; several hundred families who hid wealth had their clans exterminated.

sentences.zh: 又與勳同舉兵於桂州者尤驕暴，奪人資財，掠人婦女，勳不能制。

translations.literal: Those who had risen with Xun at Guizhou were especially arrogant and violent, seizing people's wealth and carrying off women; Xun could not control them.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had risen with Xun at Guizhou were especially violent, seizing wealth and women; Xun could not control them.

sentences.zh: 由是境內之民皆厭苦之，不聊生矣！。

translations.literal: Thereby the people within the territory all grew weary and bitter and could not live.
translations.idiomatic: Thereby the people within the territory all grew weary and could not live.

sentences.zh: 王晏權兵數退衄，朝廷命泰寧節度使曹翔代晏權為徐州北面招討使。

translations.literal: Wang Yanquan's army had repeatedly suffered setbacks; the court ordered Taining military commissioner Cao Xiang to replace Yanquan as northern Xu campaign commander.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanquan's army had repeatedly suffered setbacks. The court ordered Taining military commissioner Cao Xiang to replace him as northern Xu campaign commander.

sentences.zh: 前天雄節度使何全皞遣其將薛尤將兵萬三千人討龐勳，翔軍於滕、沛，尤軍於豐、蕭。。

translations.literal: Former Tianxiong military commissioner He Quanzhen sent his general Xue You with thirteen thousand men to campaign against Pang Xun; Xiang's army was at Teng and Pei, You's at Feng and Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: Former Tianxiong military commissioner He Quanzhen sent Xue You with thirteen thousand men against Pang Xun. Xiang encamped at Teng and Pei, You at Feng and Xiao.

sentences.zh: 是歲，江、淮旱，蝗。。

translations.literal: That year Jiang and Huai suffered drought and locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That year Jiang and Huai suffered drought and locusts.

sentences.zh: 懿宗昭聖恭孝文宗皇帝中咸通十年（己丑，公元八六九年） 。

translations.literal: Tenth year of the Xiantong era of Emperor Yizong of Tang (jichou; 869 CE).
translations.idiomatic: Tenth year of the Xiantong era of Emperor Yizong of Tang (jichou; 869 CE).

sentences.zh: 春，正月，康承訓將諸道軍七萬餘人屯柳子之西，自新興至鹿塘三十里，壁壘相屬。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, Kang Chengxun led more than seventy thousand troops from the various circuits to encamp west of Liuzi; from Xinxing to Lutang for thirty li, ramparts and camps followed one another.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, Kang Chengxun led more than seventy thousand men from all circuits to encamp west of Liuzi. From Xinxing to Lutang for thirty li, ramparts and camps lined the route.

sentences.zh: 徐兵分戍四境，城中不及數千人，龐勳始懼。

translations.literal: Xu troops were garrisoned on the four borders; in the city there were not several thousand men, and Pang Xun at last grew fearful.
translations.idiomatic: Xu troops garrisoned the four borders; fewer than several thousand remained in the city, and Pang Xun at last grew fearful.

sentences.zh: 民多穴地匿其中，勳遣人搜掘為兵，日不過得三二十人。

translations.literal: The people mostly hid in burrowed earth; Xun sent men to search and dig them out for the army, getting no more than twenty or thirty a day.
translations.idiomatic: People mostly hid in burrows. Xun sent men to dig them out for the army, getting no more than twenty or thirty a day.

sentences.zh: 勳將孟敬文守豐縣，狡悍而兵多，謀貳於勳，自為符讖。

translations.literal: Xun's general Meng Jingwen guarded Feng County, was crafty and fierce with many troops, plotted to turn against Xun, and made his own prognostications.
translations.idiomatic: Xun's general Meng Jingwen guarded Feng County—crafty, fierce, and with many troops. He plotted to turn against Xun and made his own prognostications.

sentences.zh: 勳聞之，會魏博攻豐，勳遣腹心將將三千助敬文守豐。

translations.literal: When Xun heard of it, Wei Bo was attacking Feng; Xun sent a trusted general with three thousand to help Jingwen hold Feng.
translations.idiomatic: When Xun heard, Wei Bo was attacking Feng. He sent a trusted general with three thousand to help Jingwen hold Feng.

sentences.zh: 敬文與之約共擊魏博軍，且譽其勇，使為前鋒。

translations.literal: Jingwen agreed with him to strike the Wei Bo army together and praised his courage, making him the vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: Jingwen agreed to strike Wei Bo together and praised the new troops' courage, making them the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 新軍既與魏博戰，敬文引兵退走，新軍盡沒。

translations.literal: Once the new army had joined battle with Wei Bo, Jingwen led his troops in withdrawal and flight, and the new army was entirely destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Once the new troops joined battle with Wei Bo, Jingwen withdrew and fled, and the new army was entirely destroyed.

sentences.zh: 勳乃遣使紿之曰：「王弘立已克淮南，留後欲自往鎮之。

translations.literal: Xun then sent an envoy to deceive him, saying, "Wang Hongli has already taken Huainan; the acting commissioner wishes to go himself to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: Xun then sent an envoy to deceive him: "Wang Hongli has taken Huainan. The acting commissioner wishes to garrison it himself.

sentences.zh: 悉召諸將，欲選一人可守徐州者。」

translations.literal: He is summoning all the generals and wishes to choose one who can hold Xu Prefecture."
translations.idiomatic: He summons all generals and will choose one to hold Xu Prefecture."

sentences.zh: 敬文喜，即馳詣彭城，未至城數里，勳伏兵擒之，辛酉，殺之。。

translations.literal: Jingwen was pleased and immediately galloped toward Pengcheng; several li from the city Xun's ambush seized him; on the xinyou day he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Jingwen was pleased and galloped toward Pengcheng. Several li from the city Xun's ambush seized him. On xinyou he was killed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，同昌公主適右拾遺韋保衡，以保衡為起居郎、附馬都尉。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day Princess Tongchang was married to right remonstrance Wei Baoheng; Baoheng was made attendance gentleman and imperial son-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Princess Tongchang married right remonstrance Wei Baoheng, who was made attendance gentleman and imperial son-in-law.

sentences.zh: 公主，郭淑妃之女，上特愛之，傾宮中珍玩以為資送，賜第於廣化裡，窗戶皆飾以雜寶，井欄、藥臼、槽匱亦以金銀為之，編金縷以為箕筐，賜錢五百萬緡，它物稱是。。

translations.literal: The princess was the daughter of Consort Guo Shufei; the emperor especially loved her and emptied the palace treasures for her dowry, granting a residence in Guanghua ward; windows were all adorned with mixed gems, and well rails, medicine mortars, and mangers were also of gold and silver; gold thread was woven for baskets and sieves; five million strings in cash were granted, and other goods in proportion.
translations.idiomatic: The princess was Consort Guo Shufei's daughter. The emperor especially loved her and emptied palace treasures for her dowry, granting a residence in Guanghua ward with windows adorned in gems, well rails and mortars of gold and silver, gold-thread baskets, five million strings in cash, and other goods in proportion.

sentences.zh: 徐賊寇海州。

translations.literal: Xu rebels raided Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xu rebels raided Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 時諸道兵戍海州者已數千人，斷賊所過橋柱而弗殊，仍伏兵要害以待之。

translations.literal: At that time troops from the various circuits garrisoning Haizhou already numbered several thousand; they cut the bridge pillars the rebels would pass but did not sever them completely, and still laid ambush at strategic points to await them.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops garrisoning Haizhou already numbered several thousand. They cut bridge pillars the rebels would cross but did not sever them fully, and laid ambush to await them.

sentences.zh: 賊過，橋崩，蒼黃散亂，伏兵發，盡殪之。

translations.literal: When the rebels passed, the bridges collapsed; in panic and disorder they scattered; the ambush struck and annihilated them all.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels passed, the bridges collapsed. They scattered in panic; the ambush struck and annihilated them.

sentences.zh: 其攻壽州者復為南道軍所破，斬獲數千人。

translations.literal: Those attacking Shouzhou were again broken by the southern-route army, and several thousand were beheaded or captured.
translations.idiomatic: Those attacking Shouzhou were again broken by the southern-route army; several thousand were beheaded or captured.

sentences.zh: 辛讜以浙西之軍至楚州，敕使張存誠以舟助之。

translations.literal: Xin Tan arrived with the Zhexi army at Chuzhou; edict envoy Zhang Cuncheng aided him with boats.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Tan arrived with the Zhexi army at Chuzhou; edict envoy Zhang Cuncheng aided him with boats.

sentences.zh: 徐賊水陸佈兵，鎖斷淮流。

translations.literal: Xu rebels arrayed troops by land and water and chained off the Huai current.
translations.idiomatic: Xu rebels arrayed troops by land and water and chained off the Huai.

sentences.zh: 浙西軍憚其強，不敢進，讜曰：「我請為前鋒，勝則繼之，敗則汝走。」

translations.literal: The Zhexi army feared their strength and did not dare advance; Tan said, "I ask to be vanguard—if we win, follow; if we lose, you flee."
translations.idiomatic: The Zhexi army feared their strength and would not advance. Tan said, "Let me be vanguard—if we win, follow; if we lose, flee."

sentences.zh: 猶不可。

translations.literal: Still they would not.
translations.idiomatic: Still they would not.

sentences.zh: 讜乃募選軍中敢死士數十人，牒補職名，先以米舟三艘、鹽舟一艘乘風逆流直進，賊夾攻之，矢著舟板如急雨。

translations.literal: Tan then selected several dozen daredevils from the army, issued them formal appointments on dispatch, and first sent three grain boats and one salt boat riding the wind upstream straight ahead; the rebels attacked from both sides, arrows striking the boat boards like driving rain.
translations.idiomatic: Tan selected several dozen daredevils, issued them appointments, and first sent three grain boats and one salt boat upstream against the wind. The rebels attacked from both sides; arrows struck the boards like rain.

sentences.zh: 及鎖，讜帥眾死戰，斧斷其鎖，乃得過。

translations.literal: When they reached the chain, Tan led the crowd in desperate fighting and with axes cut the chain, and only then got through.
translations.idiomatic: At the chain Tan led desperate fighting and cut it with axes, and only then got through.

sentences.zh: 城上人喧呼動地，杜慆及將佐皆泣迎之。

translations.literal: On the walls the people shouted until the earth shook; Du Tao and his generals all wept as they welcomed them.
translations.idiomatic: People on the walls shouted until the earth shook. Du Tao and his generals wept as they welcomed them.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，城上望見舟師張帆自東來，識其旗浙西軍也。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day those on the walls saw boat fleets spreading sails from the east and recognized the Zhexi banners.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou those on the walls saw sails from the east and recognized the Zhexi banners.

sentences.zh: 去城十餘里，賊列火船拒之，帆止不進。

translations.literal: More than ten li from the city the rebels arrayed fire boats to block them; the sails stopped and would not advance.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten li out the rebels arrayed fire boats to block them; the sails stopped.

sentences.zh: 慆令讜帥死士出迎之，乘戰艦沖賊陳而過，見張存誠帥米舟九艘，曰：「將士在道前卻，存誠屢欲自殺，僅得至此，今又不進。」

translations.literal: Tao ordered Tan to lead daredivils out to meet them; riding war boats they charged through the rebel formation, saw Zhang Cuncheng leading nine grain boats, and said, "Officers and soldiers on the road advanced and retreated; Cuncheng several times wished to kill himself and barely reached here, and now again will not advance."
translations.idiomatic: Tao ordered Tan to lead daredevils out. Charging through the rebel line they saw Zhang Cuncheng with nine grain boats. Tan said, "The troops on the road wavered. Cuncheng nearly killed himself to get here, and now will not advance."

sentences.zh: 讜揚言：「賊不多，甚易與耳！」

translations.literal: Tan proclaimed aloud, "The rebels are not many—very easy to deal with!"
translations.idiomatic: Tan cried aloud, "The rebels are few—very easy to handle!"

sentences.zh: 帥眾揚旗鼓噪而前，賊見其勢猛銳，避之，遂得入城。。

translations.literal: He led the crowd forward with raised drums and shouts; the rebels, seeing their momentum fierce and sharp, avoided them, and they were able to enter the city.
translations.idiomatic: He led the crowd forward with drums and shouts. The rebels, seeing their fierce momentum, avoided them, and they entered the city.

sentences.zh: 二月，端州司馬楊收長流歡州，尋賜死，其僚屬黨友坐長流嶺表者十餘人。。

translations.literal: In the second month, Duanzhou vice prefect Yang Shou was exiled to Huan Prefecture for life; soon he was granted death, and more than ten of his subordinates and partisan friends were exiled to Lingnan for life.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Duanzhou vice prefect Yang Shou was exiled to Huan Prefecture for life; soon he was put to death, and more than ten subordinates and associates were exiled to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 初，尚書右丞裴坦子娶收女，資送甚盛，器用飾以犀玉。

translations.literal: Earlier, Vice Director of the Right Department Pei Tan's son had married Shou's daughter; the dowry was very lavish and utensils were adorned with rhinoceros horn and jade.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Pei Tan's son had married Shou's daughter with a lavish dowry; utensils were adorned with rhinoceros horn and jade.

sentences.zh: 坦見之，怒曰：「破我家矣！」

translations.literal: When Tan saw it he angrily said, "You have ruined my family!"
translations.idiomatic: When Tan saw it he said angrily, "You have ruined my family!"

sentences.zh: 立命壞之。

translations.literal: He immediately ordered it destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately ordered it destroyed.

sentences.zh: 已而收竟以賄敗。。

translations.literal: Before long Shou was ruined after all through bribery.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Shou was ruined through bribery after all.

sentences.zh: 康承訓使朱邪赤心將沙陀三千騎為前鋒，陷陳卻敵，十鎮之兵伏其驍勇。

translations.literal: Chengxun sent Zhuye Chixin to lead three thousand Shatuo horsemen as vanguard; they broke the enemy line and drove them back, and the troops of ten circuits all relied on their fierceness.
translations.idiomatic: Chengxun sent Zhuye Chixin with three thousand Shatuo horsemen as vanguard. They broke the line and drove the enemy back, and troops of ten circuits relied on their fierceness.

sentences.zh: 承訓嘗引麾下千人濟渙水，賊伏兵圍之，赤心帥五百騎奮楇沖圍，拔出承訓，賊勢披靡，因合擊，敗之。

translations.literal: Chengxun once led a thousand men under his command across the Huan River; rebel ambush troops surrounded them; Chixin led five hundred horsemen in fierce charge to break the encirclement, pulled Chengxun out, the rebels' momentum collapsed, and they joined in the attack and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Chengxun once led a thousand men across the Huan River. Rebel ambush surrounded them. Chixin led five hundred horsemen in fierce charge, broke the encirclement, pulled Chengxun out, and they routed the rebels.

sentences.zh: 承訓數與賊戰，賊軍屢敗。

translations.literal: Chengxun fought the rebels several times and the rebel army was repeatedly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Chengxun fought the rebels repeatedly and the rebel army was repeatedly defeated.

sentences.zh: 王弘立自矜淮口之捷，請獨將所部三萬人破承訓，龐勳許之。

translations.literal: Wang Hongli, proud of his victory at the Huai mouth, asked to lead his own division of thirty thousand men alone to defeat Chengxun; Pang Xun agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hongli, proud of his Huai mouth victory, asked to lead his thirty thousand men alone to defeat Chengxun. Pang Xun agreed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，弘立引兵渡濉水，夜，襲鹿塘塞，黎明，圍之。

translations.literal: On the jihai day Hongli led his troops across the Sui River; at night he raided the Lutang stockade; at dawn he besieged it.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Hongli crossed the Sui River, raided the Lutang stockade at night, and besieged it at dawn.

sentences.zh: 弘立與諸將臨望，自謂功在漏刻。

translations.literal: Hongli and the generals looked down from afar and considered the achievement within the water clock's drip.
translations.idiomatic: Hongli and his generals looked down and thought victory was within the hour.

sentences.zh: 沙陀左右突圍，出入如飛，賊紛擾移避，沙陀縱騎蹂之，寨中諸軍爭出奮擊，賊大敗。

translations.literal: The Shatuo broke out left and right, coming and going like flight; the rebels shifted and dodged in disorder; the Shatuo let their horsemen trample them; the troops in the stockade all vied to rush out and strike; the rebels were utterly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: The Shatuo broke out left and right like flight. The rebels scattered. The Shatuo trampled them; garrison troops rushed out and struck. The rebels were utterly defeated.

sentences.zh: 官軍蹙之於濉水，溺死者不可勝紀，自鹿塘至襄城，伏屍五十里，斬首二萬餘級，弘立單騎走免，所驅掠平民皆散走山谷，不復還營，委棄資糧、器械山積。

translations.literal: The government army pressed them to the Sui River; those who drowned were beyond counting; from Lutang to Xiangcheng corpses lay for fifty li; more than twenty thousand heads were cut off; Hongli alone fled on horseback and escaped; the common people he had driven to plunder all scattered into mountains and valleys and did not return to camp, abandoning grain, supplies, and weapons heaped like hills.
translations.idiomatic: The government army drove them to the Sui River; countless drowned. From Lutang to Xiangcheng corpses lay for fifty li; more than twenty thousand were beheaded. Hongli alone escaped. Plundered civilians scattered into the hills and abandoned supplies heaped like hills.

sentences.zh: 時有敕，諸軍破賊，得農民，皆釋之，自是賊每與官軍遇，其驅掠之民先自潰。

translations.literal: At that time there was an edict that in all armies defeating rebels, peasants taken were to be released; thereafter whenever rebels met government troops, the people they had driven to plunder would first break on their own.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that peasants captured in defeating rebels be released. Thereafter whenever rebels met government troops, the people they drove to plunder would break first.

sentences.zh: 龐勳、許佶以弘立驕惰致敗，欲斬之，周重為之說勳曰：「弘立再勝未賞，一敗而誅之，棄功錄過，為敵報仇，諸將咸懼矣。

translations.literal: Pang Xun and Xu Ji, because Hongli's arrogance and indolence had brought defeat, wished to behead him; Zhou Chong pleaded for him to Xun, saying, "Hongli was not rewarded for two victories yet is to be executed for one defeat—discarding merit and recording faults, avenging the enemy; the generals will all be afraid.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Xun and Xu Ji wished to behead Hongli for arrogance and indolence. Zhou Chong pleaded: "Hongli was not rewarded for two victories yet is to die for one defeat—discarding merit, recording faults, avenging the enemy. The generals will all fear.

sentences.zh: 不若赦之，責其後效。」

translations.literal: Better to pardon him and demand later achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Better to pardon him and demand later achievement.

sentences.zh: 勳乃釋之。

translations.literal: Xun then released him.
translations.idiomatic: Xun released him.

sentences.zh: 弘立收散卒才得數百人，請取泗州以補過，勳益其兵而遣之。。

translations.literal: Hongli gathered scattered troops to only several hundred men, asked to take Sizhou to make amends, and Xun increased his troops and sent him.
translations.idiomatic: Hongli gathered only several hundred scattered troops, asked to take Sizhou to atone, and Xun increased his troops and sent him.

sentences.zh: 三月，辛未，以起居郎韋保衡為左諫議大夫，充翰林學士。。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the xinwei day, attendance gentleman Wei Baoheng was made left remonstrance grandee and Hanlin academician.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinwei, attendance gentleman Wei Baoheng was made left remonstrance grandee and Hanlin academician.

sentences.zh: 徙郢王侃為威王。。

translations.literal: Prince of E Wang Kan was transferred to be Prince of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of E Wang Kan was transferred to be Prince of Wei.

sentences.zh: 康承訓既破王弘立，進逼柳子，與姚週一月之間數十戰。

translations.literal: After Kang Chengxun had defeated Wang Hongli he pressed close to Liuzi and with Yao Zhou fought several tens of battles within one month.
translations.idiomatic: After defeating Wang Hongli, Chengxun pressed Liuzi and fought Yao Zhou several tens of times within a month.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，周引兵渡水，官軍急擊之，周退走，官軍逐之，遂圍柳子。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day Zhou led troops across the water; the government army pressed the attack; Zhou withdrew and fled; the government army pursued and then besieged Liuzi.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Zhou led troops across the water. The government army pressed him; Zhou fled; they pursued and besieged Liuzi.

sentences.zh: 會大風，四面縱火，賊棄寨走，沙陀以精騎邀之，屠殺殆盡，自柳子至芳城，死者相枕，斬其將劉豐。

translations.literal: A great wind arose; fire was set on all four sides; the rebels abandoned the stockade and fled; the Shatuo with elite horsemen intercepted them and slaughtered nearly all; from Liuzi to Fangcheng the dead lay one upon another; their general Liu Feng was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: A great wind arose and fire was set on all sides. The rebels fled. The Shatuo intercepted and slaughtered nearly all. From Liuzi to Fangcheng the dead lay piled; general Liu Feng was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 周將麾下數十人奔宿州，宿州守將梁丕素與之有隙，開城聽入，執死斬之。

translations.literal: Zhou led several dozen men under his command to flee to Suzhou; Suzhou garrison commander Liang Pi had long had a feud with him, opened the gates to let him in, seized and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou fled to Suzhou with several dozen men. Garrison commander Liang Pi, who had long feuded with him, opened the gates, seized him, and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 龐勳聞之大懼，與許佶議自將出戰。

translations.literal: When Pang Xun heard of it he was greatly afraid and discussed with Xu Ji personally leading troops out to fight.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Xun was greatly afraid and discussed with Xu Ji leading troops out personally.

sentences.zh: 周重泣言於勳曰：「柳子地要兵精，姚周勇敢有謀，今一旦覆沒，危如累卵，不若遂建大號，悉兵四出，決死力戰。」

translations.literal: Zhou Chong wept and said to Xun, "Liuzi is strategically vital with elite troops; Yao Zhou is brave and resourceful—now in one day all is overturned, perilous as piled eggs. Better immediately to establish a great title, marshal all troops on four sides, and fight to the death.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Chong wept and said to Xun, "Liuzi is vital and Yao Zhou brave—now all is lost, perilous as piled eggs. Better establish a great title at once, marshal all troops, and fight to the death.

sentences.zh: 又勸殺崔彥曾以絕人望。

translations.literal: He also urged killing Cui Yanzeng to cut off people's hopes.
translations.idiomatic: He also urged killing Cui Yanzeng to cut off hope.

sentences.zh: 術士曹君長亦言：「徐州山川不容兩帥，今觀察使尚在，故留後未興。」

translations.literal: Diviner Cao Junchang also said, "The mountains and rivers of Xu Prefecture cannot hold two commanders; now the observation commissioner is still alive, and therefore the acting commissioner has not risen.
translations.idiomatic: Diviner Cao Junchang also said, "Xu's mountains and rivers cannot hold two commanders. While the observation commissioner lives, the acting commissioner cannot rise.

sentences.zh: 賊黨皆以為然。

translations.literal: The rebel partisans all thought it correct.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel partisans all agreed.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，壬辰，勳殺彥曾及監軍張道謹、宣慰使仇大夫，僚佐焦璐、溫庭皓等，並其親屬、賓客、僕妾皆死；

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the renchen day, Xun killed Yanzeng, army supervisor Zhang Daojin, consolation commissioner Qiu Dafu, staff members Jiao Lu, Wen Tinghao, and others, and their kin, guests, and concubines all died;
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on renchen, Xun killed Yanzeng, army supervisor Zhang Daojin, consolation commissioner Qiu Dafu, staff Jiao Lu, Wen Tinghao, and others, with all their kin, guests, and concubines;

sentences.zh: 斷淮南監軍郭厚本、都押衙李湘手足，以示康承訓軍。

translations.literal: he cut off the hands and feet of Huainan army supervisor Guo Houben and chief military adjutant Li Xiang and displayed them to Kang Chengxun's army.
translations.idiomatic: he cut off the hands and feet of Huainan supervisor Houben and adjutant Li Xiang and displayed them to Chengxun's army.

sentences.zh: 勳乃集眾揚言曰：「勳始望國恩，庶全臣節；

translations.literal: Xun then assembled the crowd and proclaimed, "At first Xun hoped for the state's grace and wished to preserve ministerial integrity;
translations.idiomatic: Xun assembled the crowd and proclaimed, "At first I hoped for the state's grace and wished to remain a loyal minister;

sentences.zh: 今日之事，前志之乖。

translations.literal: today's affair is a departure from former intent.
translations.idiomatic: today's affair departs from that intent.

sentences.zh: 自此，勳與諸君真反者也，當掃境內之兵，戮力同心，轉敗為功耳。」

translations.literal: From this time Xun and you gentlemen are truly rebels; we must sweep the troops within the borders, join strength in one heart, and turn defeat into victory.
translations.idiomatic: From now I and you are truly rebels. We must sweep the realm's troops, join in one heart, and turn defeat into victory.

sentences.zh: 眾皆稱善。

translations.literal: The crowd all called it good.
translations.idiomatic: The crowd all approved.

sentences.zh: 於是命城中男子悉集球場，仍分遣諸將比屋大索，敢匿一男子都族其家。

translations.literal: He then ordered all able-bodied men in the city to assemble in the ball ground, and separately sent the generals to search house by house; anyone hiding a single man had his whole clan exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered all able-bodied men to assemble in the ball ground and sent generals to search house by house; anyone hiding a man had his whole clan exterminated.

sentences.zh: 選丁壯，得三萬人，要造旗幟，給以精兵。

translations.literal: Selecting able-bodied men, he got thirty thousand, required them to make banners and flags, and gave them elite troops.
translations.idiomatic: He selected thirty thousand able-bodied men, required banners and flags, and gave them elite troops.

sentences.zh: 許佶等共推勳為天冊將軍、大會明王。

translations.literal: Xu Ji and the others together pushed Xun as Heavenly-Mandate General and Great Assembly Bright King.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Ji and others pushed Xun as Heavenly-Mandate General and Great Assembly Bright King.

sentences.zh: 勳辭王爵。。

translations.literal: Xun declined the royal title.
translations.idiomatic: Xun declined the royal title.

sentences.zh: 先是，辛讜復自泗州引驍勇四百人迎糧於揚、潤，賊夾岸攻之，轉戰百里，乃得出。

translations.literal: Earlier Xin Tan again led four hundred fierce men from Sizhou to meet grain at Yang and Run; the rebels attacked from both banks; after fighting a hundred li they at last got out.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Xin Tan again led four hundred fierce men from Sizhou to fetch grain at Yang and Run. Rebels attacked from both banks; after fighting a hundred li they escaped.

sentences.zh: 至廣陵，止於公館，不敢歸家，舟載鹽米二萬石，錢萬三千緡，乙未，還至斗山。

translations.literal: When he reached Guangling he stopped at the official hostel and did not dare return home; his boats carried twenty thousand shi of salt and rice and thirteen thousand strings in cash; on the yiwei day he returned to Doushan.
translations.idiomatic: At Guangling he stopped at the official hostel and dared not go home. His boats carried twenty thousand shi of salt and rice and thirteen thousand strings in cash. On yiwei he returned to Doushan.

sentences.zh: 賊將王弘芝帥眾萬餘，拒之於盱胎，密佈戰艦百五十艘以塞淮流，又縱火船逆之。

translations.literal: Rebel general Wang Hongzhi led more than ten thousand to block him at Xuyi, secretly arraying a hundred fifty war boats to block the Huai current, and also sent fire boats against them.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel general Wang Hongzhi led more than ten thousand to block him at Xuyi, arraying a hundred fifty war boats to block the Huai and sending fire boats against them.

sentences.zh: 讜命以長叉托過，自卯戰及未，眾寡不敵，官軍不利。

translations.literal: Tan ordered long forks used to push past; from the mao hour they fought until the wei hour; their numbers could not match the enemy and the government army fared ill.
translations.idiomatic: Tan used long forks to push past. From mao to wei they fought; outnumbered, the government army fared ill.

sentences.zh: 賊縛木於戰艦，旁出四五尺為戰棚，讜命勇士乘小舟入其下，矢刃所不能及，以槍揭火牛焚之，戰艦既然，賊皆潰走，官軍乃得過入城。

translations.literal: The rebels bound timbers to the war boats, extending four or five chi on the sides as fighting platforms; Tan ordered brave men in small boats to enter beneath them where arrows and blades could not reach, used spears to lift fire oxen and burn them; once the war boats were ablaze the rebels all broke and fled, and the government army was able to pass and enter the city.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels bound timbers to war boats as fighting platforms. Tan sent brave men in small boats beneath, where blades could not reach, and burned them with fire oxen. The war boats blazed; the rebels fled and the government army entered the city.

sentences.zh: 龐勳以父舉直為大司馬，與許佶等留守徐州。

translations.literal: Pang Xun made his father Pang Juzhi grand marshal and left him with Xu Ji and others to hold Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Xun made his father Juzhi grand marshal and left him with Xu Ji to hold Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 或曰：「將軍方耀兵威，不可以父子之親，失上下之節。」

translations.literal: Someone said, "The general is now displaying military might—father and son's intimacy must not lose the propriety of superior and inferior."
translations.idiomatic: Someone said, "The general displays military might—father and son must not lose superior-inferior propriety."

sentences.zh: 乃令舉直趨拜於庭，勳據案而受之。

translations.literal: He then ordered Juzhi to hurry forward and bow in the hall, and Xun received the bow seated at his desk.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Juzhi to hurry forward and bow in the hall while Xun received it seated at his desk.

sentences.zh: 時魏博屢圍豐縣，龐勳欲先擊之，丙申，引兵發徐州。。

translations.literal: At that time Wei Bo repeatedly besieged Feng County; Pang Xun wished to strike them first; on the bingshen day he led troops out from Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Bo repeatedly besieged Feng County. Pang Xun wished to strike them first. On bingshen he led troops out from Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以前淮南節度使、同平章事令狐綯為太保、分司。。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day former Huainan military commissioner and Associate Grand Councilor Linghu Tao was made grand mentor with a separate court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, former Huainan military commissioner and Associate Grand Councilor Linghu Tao was made grand mentor with a separate court.

sentences.zh: 龐勳夜至豐縣，潛入城，魏博軍皆不之知。

translations.literal: Pang Xun by night reached Feng County and secretly entered the city; the Wei Bo army knew nothing of it.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Xun reached Feng County by night and secretly entered the city; the Wei Bo army knew nothing.

sentences.zh: 魏博分為五寨，其近城者屯數千人，勳縱兵圍之，諸寨救之，勳仗兵要路，殺官軍二千人，餘皆返走。

translations.literal: Wei Bo was divided into five stockades; those nearest the city garrisoned several thousand men; Xun unleashed troops to besiege them; the stockades came to rescue; Xun held the strategic roads with troops and killed two thousand government soldiers; the rest all fled back.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Bo had five stockades; the nearest garrisoned several thousand. Xun besieged them; other stockades came to rescue; Xun held the roads and killed two thousand government soldiers; the rest fled.

sentences.zh: 賊攻塞不克，至夜，解圍去。

translations.literal: The rebels could not take the stockade and by night lifted the siege and left.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels could not take the stockade and by night lifted the siege.

sentences.zh: 官軍畏其眾，且聞勳自來，諸寨皆宵潰。

translations.literal: The government army feared their numbers, and hearing Xun had come in person, all stockades fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: The government army feared their numbers, and hearing Xun had come in person, all stockades fled by night.

sentences.zh: 曹翔方圍滕縣，聞魏博敗，引兵退保兗州。

translations.literal: Cao Xiang was besieging Teng County when he heard Wei Bo had been defeated; he led his troops back to hold Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Xiang was besieging Teng County when he heard Wei Bo was defeated; he withdrew to hold Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 賊悉毀其城柵，運其資糧，傳檄徐州，盛自誇大，謂官軍為國賊雲。。

translations.literal: The rebels destroyed all their ramparts and palisades, transported their grain and supplies, and spread proclamations to Xu Prefecture, greatly boasting themselves and calling the government army state rebels.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels destroyed their ramparts, transported supplies, and spread proclamations to Xu Prefecture, greatly boasting and calling the government army state rebels.

sentences.zh: 馬舉將精兵三萬救泗州，乙巳，分軍三道渡淮，至中流，大噪，聲聞數里。

translations.literal: Ma Ju led thirty thousand elite troops to rescue Sizhou; on the yisi day he divided his army into three columns to cross the Huai; midstream they shouted greatly, their voices heard for several li.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Ju led thirty thousand elite troops to rescue Sizhou. On yisi he divided into three columns to cross the Huai; midstream they shouted, heard for several li.

sentences.zh: 賊大驚，不測眾寡，斂兵屯城西寨。

translations.literal: The rebels were greatly alarmed, unable to gauge their numbers, gathered troops, and encamped at the western stockade outside the city.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels were greatly alarmed, unable to gauge their numbers, and encamped at the western stockade outside the city.

sentences.zh: 舉就圍之，縱火焚柵，賊眾大敗，斬首數千級。

translations.literal: Ju immediately besieged them, set fire and burned the palisades; the rebel host was utterly defeated and several thousand heads were cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Ju immediately besieged them, burned the palisades, and utterly defeated the rebels; several thousand were beheaded.

sentences.zh: 王弘立死，吳迥退保徐城，泗州之圍始解。

translations.literal: Wang Hongli died; Wu Tong withdrew to hold Xucheng; the siege of Sizhou at last was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hongli died. Wu Tong withdrew to Xucheng. The siege of Sizhou was at last lifted.

sentences.zh: 泗州被圍凡七月，守城者不得寐，面目皆生瘡。。

translations.literal: Sizhou had been besieged seven months in all; the defenders could not sleep, and sores grew on their faces.
translations.idiomatic: Sizhou had been besieged seven months; defenders could not sleep and sores grew on their faces.

sentences.zh: 龐勳留豐縣數日，欲引兵西擊康承訓，或曰：「天時向暑，蠶麥方急，不若且休兵聚食，然後圖之。」

translations.literal: Pang Xun stayed several days at Feng County and wished to lead troops west to strike Kang Chengxun; someone said, "The season is turning hot; silkworms and wheat are urgently needed—better rest the troops and gather food, then plan.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Xun stayed several days at Feng County and wished to march west against Chengxun. Someone said, "The season turns hot and silkworms and wheat are urgent—better rest and gather food, then plan.

sentences.zh: 或曰：「將軍出師數日，摧七萬之眾，西軍震恐，乘此聲勢，彼破走必矣，時不可失。」

translations.literal: Someone said, "The general has marched several days and crushed seventy thousand men; the western army is shaken with terror—seize this momentum and they will surely break and flee; the moment must not be lost.
translations.idiomatic: Someone said, "You have crushed seventy thousand in days; the western army is terrified—seize this momentum and they will break and flee. The moment must not be lost.

sentences.zh: 龐舉直以書勸勳乘勝進軍，勳意遂決。

translations.literal: Pang Juzhi by letter urged Xun to advance while victory was hot, and Xun's mind was decided.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Juzhi urged Xun by letter to advance while victory was hot, and Xun decided.

sentences.zh: 丁未，發豐縣，庚戌，至蕭。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day he set out from Feng County; on the gengxu day he reached Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he set out from Feng County; on gengxu he reached Xiao.

sentences.zh: 約襄城、留武、小睢諸寨兵合五六萬人，以二十九日遲明攻柳子。

translations.literal: He arranged for the stockades at Xiangcheng, Liuwu, and Xiaosui to combine fifty or sixty thousand troops to attack Liuzi at dawn on the twenty-ninth day.
translations.idiomatic: He arranged for stockades at Xiangcheng, Liuwu, and Xiaosui to combine fifty or sixty thousand men to attack Liuzi at dawn on the twenty-ninth.

sentences.zh: 淮南敗卒在賊中者，逃詣康承訓，告以其期。

translations.literal: Huainan defeated soldiers among the rebels fled to Kang Chengxun and told him the date.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan defeated soldiers among the rebels fled to Chengxun and told him the date.

sentences.zh: 承訓得先為之備，秣馬整眾，設伏以待之。

translations.literal: Chengxun was able to prepare first, fed the horses and marshaled the host, and set ambush to await them.
translations.idiomatic: Chengxun prepared first, fed horses, marshaled troops, and set ambush.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，襄城等兵先至柳子，遇伏，敗走。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day the Xiangcheng troops and others reached Liuzi first, met the ambush, and were defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the Xiangcheng troops reached Liuzi first, met ambush, and fled defeated.

sentences.zh: 龐勳既自失期，遽引兵自三十里外赴之，比至，諸寨已敗，勳所將皆市井白徒，睹官軍勢盛，皆不戰而潰。

translations.literal: Pang Xun had himself missed the rendezvous and hastily led troops from more than thirty li away to hurry there; when he arrived the various stockades had already been defeated; those Xun led were all marketplace rabble; seeing the government army's momentum formidable, none fought and all broke.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Xun had missed the rendezvous and hurried from more than thirty li away. When he arrived the stockades were already defeated. His troops were marketplace rabble; seeing the government army's strength, none fought and all broke.

sentences.zh: 承訓命諸將急追之，以騎兵邀其前，步卒蹙其後，賊狼狽不知所之，自相蹈藉，殭屍數十里，死者數萬人。

translations.literal: Chengxun ordered the generals to pursue urgently, used cavalry to intercept them in front and infantry to press them from behind; the rebels fled in disorder not knowing where to go, trampled one another, and corpses lay for several tens of li; tens of thousands died.
translations.idiomatic: Chengxun ordered urgent pursuit, cavalry in front and infantry behind. The rebels fled in disorder, trampled one another; corpses lay for tens of li; tens of thousands died.

sentences.zh: 勳解甲服布襦而遁，收散卒，才及三千人，歸彭城，使其將張實分諸寨兵屯第城驛。

translations.literal: Xun doffed his armor, wore cloth short coats, and escaped; he gathered scattered troops to only three thousand men, returned to Pengcheng, and sent his general Zhang Shi to divide stockade troops to garrison Dicheng relay station.
translations.idiomatic: Xun doffed armor, wore cloth coats, and escaped. He gathered only three thousand scattered troops, returned to Pengcheng, and sent Zhang Shi to garrison Dicheng relay.

sentences.zh: 勳初起，下邳土豪鄭鎰聚眾三千，自備資糧器械以應之，勳以為將，謂之義軍。

translations.literal: When Xun first rose, Xiapi local strongman Zheng Yin gathered three thousand men, prepared their own grain, supplies, and weapons to answer him; Xun made him a general and called them the Righteous Army.
translations.idiomatic: When Xun first rose, Xiapi strongman Zheng Yin gathered three thousand with their own supplies to join him. Xun made him a general and called them the Righteous Army.

sentences.zh: 五月，沂州遣軍圍下邳，勳命鎰救之，鎰帥所部來降。。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Yizhou sent troops to besiege Xiapi; Xun ordered Yin to rescue it; Yin led his division to come over and surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Yizhou besieged Xiapi. Xun ordered Yin to rescue it; Yin led his men to surrender instead.

sentences.zh: 六月，陝民作亂，逐觀察使崔蕘。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the people of Shan made trouble, drove out observation commissioner Cui Rao.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the people of Shan rebelled and drove out observation commissioner Cui Rao.

sentences.zh: 蕘以器韻自矜，不親政事，民訴旱，蕘指庭樹曰：「此尚有葉，何旱之有！」

translations.literal: Rao prided himself on the tone of his vessels and did not personally handle government affairs; when the people complained of drought Rao pointed at a tree in the courtyard and said, "This still has leaves—how can there be drought!"
translations.idiomatic: Rao prided himself on the tone of his vessels and did not govern. When the people complained of drought he pointed at a courtyard tree: "It still has leaves—how can there be drought!"

sentences.zh: 杖之。

translations.literal: And had them beaten.
translations.idiomatic: And had them beaten.

sentences.zh: 民怒，故逐之。

translations.literal: The people were enraged and therefore drove him out.
translations.idiomatic: The people were enraged and drove him out.

sentences.zh: 蕘逃於民舍，渴求飲，民以溺飲之。

translations.literal: Rao fled to a commoner's house, desperately thirsty and begging drink; the people gave him urine to drink.
translations.idiomatic: Rao fled to a commoner's house, desperately thirsty; the people gave him urine to drink.

sentences.zh: 坐貶昭州司馬。。

translations.literal: He was demoted to Zhao Prefecture vice prefect on account of it.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted to Zhao Prefecture vice prefect.

sentences.zh: 以中書侍郎、同平章事徐商同平章事，充荊南節度使。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Secretariat and Associate Grand Councilor Xu Shang was made Associate Grand Councilor and Jingnan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director Xu Shang was made Associate Grand Councilor and Jingnan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以翰林學士承旨、戶部侍郎劉瞻同平章事。

translations.literal: On the guimao day Hanlin academician ex officio and Vice Minister of Revenue Liu Zhan was made Associate Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Hanlin ex officio and Vice Minister of Revenue Liu Zhan was made Associate Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 瞻，桂州人也。。

translations.literal: Zhan was a man of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhan was from Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 馬舉自泗州引兵攻濠州，拔招義、鐘離、定遠。

translations.literal: Ma Ju led troops from Sizhou to attack Haozhou, taking Zhaoyi, Zhongli, and Dingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Ju led troops from Sizhou to attack Haozhou, taking Zhaoyi, Zhongli, and Dingyuan.

sentences.zh: 劉行及設寨於城外以拒守，舉先遣輕騎挑戰，賊見其眾少，爭出寨西擊之，舉引大軍數萬自它道擊其東南，遂焚其寨。

translations.literal: Liu Xingji set up a stockade outside the city to resist; Ju first sent light cavalry to challenge; the rebels, seeing their numbers few, vied to rush out of the stockade west to strike them; Ju led a great host of tens of thousands by another route to strike their southeast, then burned their stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xingji set a stockade outside the city. Ju sent light cavalry to challenge; the rebels, seeing few numbers, rushed west to strike. Ju led tens of thousands by another route to strike their southeast and burned the stockade.

sentences.zh: 賊入固守，舉塹其三面而圍之，北面臨淮，賊猶得與徐州通。

translations.literal: The rebels entered and held firm; Ju trenched three sides and besieged them; the north faced the Huai, and the rebels could still communicate with Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels held firm inside. Ju trenched three sides and besieged; the north faced the Huai, and rebels could still reach Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 龐勳遣吳迥助行及守濠州，屯兵北津以相應，舉遣別將渡淮擊之，斬獲數千人，平其寨。。

translations.literal: Pang Xun sent Wu Tong to help Xingji hold Haozhou, garrisoning troops at the north ford to coordinate; Ju sent a separate general across the Huai to strike them, beheading and capturing several thousand, and leveled their stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Xun sent Wu Tong to help Xingji hold Haozhou, garrisoning the north ford. Ju sent a general across the Huai, beheaded and captured several thousand, and leveled the stockade.

sentences.zh: 曹翔之退屯兗州也，留滄州卒四千人戍魯橋，卒擅還，翔曰：「以龐勳作亂，故討之。

translations.literal: When Cao Xiang had withdrawn to encamp at Yanzhou he left four thousand Cangzhou soldiers to garrison Luqiao; the soldiers returned on their own authority; Xiang said, "Because Pang Xun made rebellion we campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: When Cao Xiang withdrew to Yanzhou he left four thousand Cangzhou soldiers at Luqiao; they returned without orders. Xiang said, "We campaign because Pang Xun rebelled.

sentences.zh: 今滄卒不從約束，是自亂也。」

translations.literal: Now the Cang troops do not obey restraint—that is rebellion in itself."
translations.idiomatic: Now Cang troops disobey—that is rebellion itself."

sentences.zh: 勒兵迎之，圍於兗州城外，擇違命者二千人，悉誅之。

translations.literal: He marshaled troops to meet them, besieged them outside Yanzhou city, selected two thousand who had disobeyed orders, and had them all executed.
translations.idiomatic: He marshaled troops, besieged them outside Yanzhou, selected two thousand who had disobeyed, and executed them all.

sentences.zh: 朝廷聞魏博軍敗，以將軍宋威為徐州西北面招討使，將兵三萬屯於豐、蕭之間，翔復引兵會之。。

translations.literal: When the court heard Wei Bo's army had been defeated it appointed general Song Wei as northwestern Xu campaign commander, leading thirty thousand troops to encamp between Feng and Xiao; Xiang again led troops to join him.
translations.idiomatic: When the court heard Wei Bo was defeated it appointed Song Wei northwestern Xu campaign commander with thirty thousand troops between Feng and Xiao; Xiang again joined him.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，康承訓克臨渙，殺獲萬人，遂拔襄城、留武、小睢等寨。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Kang Chengxun took Linhuan, killed and captured ten thousand men, and then took the stockades at Xiangcheng, Liuwu, Xiaosui, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, Kang Chengxun took Linhuan, killed and captured ten thousand, and took stockades at Xiangcheng, Liuwu, Xiaosui, and others.

sentences.zh: 曹翔拔滕縣，進擊豐、沛。

translations.literal: Cao Xiang took Teng County and advanced to attack Feng and Pei.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Xiang took Teng County and advanced to attack Feng and Pei.

sentences.zh: 賊諸寨戍兵多相帥逃匿，保據山林，賊抄掠者過之，輒為所殺，而五八村尤甚。

translations.literal: Garrison soldiers in the various rebel stockades mostly led one another in flight and concealment, holding to mountains and forests; when rebel plunderers passed by they were killed, and the Five-Eight Villages were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison troops in rebel stockades mostly fled to mountains and forests. When rebel plunderers passed they were killed—the Five-Eight Villages especially so.

sentences.zh: 有陳全裕者為之帥，凡叛勳者皆歸之，眾至數千人，戰守之具皆備，環地數十里，賊莫敢近。

translations.literal: There was a Chen Quanyu who became their leader; all who had turned against Xun returned to him; the crowd reached several thousand men; fighting and defense equipment were all complete; for several tens of li around the land none dared approach.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Quanyu became their leader. All who had rebelled against Xun joined him until they numbered several thousand, fully armed, holding several tens of li that rebels dared not approach.

sentences.zh: 康承訓遣人招之，遂舉眾來降，賊黨益離。

translations.literal: Kang Chengxun sent men to recruit them; they then led the multitude to surrender; rebel partisans grew ever more scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Chengxun sent men to recruit them. They surrendered with their followers, and rebel partisans scattered further.

sentences.zh: 蘄縣土豪李兗殺賊守將，舉城降於承訓。

translations.literal: Qizhou local strongman Li Yan killed the rebel garrison commander and surrendered the city to Chengxun.
translations.idiomatic: Qizhou strongman Li Yan killed the rebel garrison commander and surrendered the city to Chengxun.

sentences.zh: 沛縣守將李直詣彭城計事，裨將朱玫舉城降於曹翔。

translations.literal: Pei County garrison commander Li Zhi went to Pengcheng to discuss affairs; vice general Zhu Mei surrendered the city to Cao Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: Pei garrison commander Li Zhi went to Pengcheng on business. Vice general Zhu Mei surrendered the city to Cao Xiang.

sentences.zh: 直自彭城還，玫逆擊，走之，翔發兵戍沛。

translations.literal: When Zhi returned from Pengcheng, Mei met and struck him and drove him off; Xiang sent troops to garrison Pei.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhi returned from Pengcheng, Mei met and drove him off. Xiang sent troops to garrison Pei.

sentences.zh: 玫，邠州人也。

translations.literal: Mei was a man of Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mei was from Bin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 勳遣其將孫章、許佶各將數千人攻陳全裕、朱玫，皆不克而還。

translations.literal: Xun sent his generals Sun Zhang and Xu Ji, each with several thousand men, to attack Chen Quanyu and Zhu Mei; both failed and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Xun sent Sun Zhang and Xu Ji, each with several thousand men, against Chen Quanyu and Zhu Mei. Both failed and returned.

sentences.zh: 康承訓乘勝長驅，拔第城，進抵宿州之西，築城而守之。

translations.literal: Kang Chengxun took advantage of victory to drive on a long pursuit, took Dicheng, advanced to west of Suzhou, and built a city to hold it.
translations.idiomatic: Chengxun drove on in victory, took Dicheng, advanced west of Suzhou, and built a fortified camp.

sentences.zh: 龐勳憂懣不知所為，但禱神飯僧而已。。

translations.literal: Pang Xun was distressed and vexed and knew not what to do, only praying to the gods and feeding monks.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Xun was distressed and knew not what to do, only praying to gods and feeding monks.

sentences.zh: 初，龐勳怒梁丕專殺姚周，黜之，使徐州舊將張玄稔代之治州事，以其黨張儒、張實等將城中兵數萬拒官軍。

translations.literal: Earlier Pang Xun, angry that Liang Pi had on his own authority killed Yao Zhou, removed him and had old Xu general Zhang Xuanchen replace him to govern the prefecture, with his partisans Zhang Ru, Zhang Shi, and others leading tens of thousands of city troops to resist the government army.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Xun, angry that Liang Pi had killed Yao Zhou on his own authority, removed him and had old Xu general Zhang Xuanchen govern the prefecture, with partisans Zhang Ru and Zhang Shi leading tens of thousands to resist the government army.

sentences.zh: 儒等列寨數重於城外，環水自固；

translations.literal: Ru and the others arrayed stockades in several rings outside the city and ringed water to secure themselves;
translations.idiomatic: Ru arrayed stockades in several rings outside the city and used water to secure themselves;

sentences.zh: 康承訓圍之。

translations.literal: Kang Chengxun besieged them.
translations.idiomatic: Chengxun besieged them.

sentences.zh: 張實夜遣人潛出，以書白勳曰：「今國兵盡在城下，西方必虛，將軍宜引兵出其不意，掠宋、亳之郊，彼必解圍而西，將軍設伏要害，迎擊其前，實等出城中兵蹙其後，破之必矣！」

translations.literal: Zhang Shi by night sent men secretly out with a letter telling Xun, "Now the state's troops are all below the city; the west is sure to be empty. The general should lead troops by surprise, plunder the outskirts of Song and Bo—the enemy is sure to lift the siege and go west; the general should set ambush at strategic points and strike them in front; Shi and the others will lead city troops to press from behind—defeat is certain!"
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shi sent men out by night with a letter: "State troops are all below the city; the west is empty. Lead troops by surprise, plunder Song and Bo—the enemy will lift the siege and go west. Set ambush and strike in front; we will press from behind—certain victory!"

sentences.zh: 時曹翔使朱玫擊豐，破之，乘勝攻徐城、下邳，皆拔之，斬獲萬計。

translations.literal: At that time Cao Xiang had Zhu Mei attack Feng and defeat it, took advantage of victory to attack Xucheng and Xiapi, and took them all, beheading and capturing to the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Xiang had Zhu Mei attack Feng and win, then took Xucheng and Xiapi, beheading and capturing to the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 勳方憂懼欲走，得實書，即從其策，使龐舉直、許佶守徐州，引兵而西。。

translations.literal: Xun was just distressed and fearful and wished to flee; receiving Shi's letter he followed the plan, made Pang Juzhi and Xu Ji hold Xu Prefecture, and led troops west.
translations.idiomatic: Xun was distressed and wished to flee. Receiving Shi's letter he followed the plan, left Juzhi and Xu Ji at Xu, and led troops west.

sentences.zh: 八月，壬子，康承訓焚外寨，張儒等入保羅城，官軍攻之，死者數千人，不能克，承訓患之，遣辯士於城下招諭之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the renzi day, Kang Chengxun burned the outer stockades; Zhang Ru and the others entered and held the outer wall; the government army attacked; several thousand died and could not take it; Chengxun was troubled by it and sent eloquent men below the walls to persuade them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renzi, Chengxun burned the outer stockades. Zhang Ru entered the outer wall. The government army attacked; several thousand died and could not take it. Chengxun sent persuaders below the walls.

sentences.zh: 張玄稔嘗戍邊有功，雖脅從於賊，心嘗憂憤，時將所部兵守子城，夜，召所親數十人謀歸國，因稍令布諭，協同者眾，乃遣腹心張皋夜出，以狀白承訓，約期殺賊將，舉城降，至日，請立青旌為應，使眾心無疑。

translations.literal: Zhang Xuanchen had long served on the frontier with achievement; though coerced to follow the rebels, his heart had always been troubled and indignant; at the time he was leading his troops to guard the inner city; at night he summoned several dozen close followers to plan returning to the state, gradually spread word, and those who agreed were many; he then sent trusted man Zhang Gao out by night with the situation to inform Chengxun, fixing a date to kill the rebel generals and surrender the city; on that day he asked to raise a blue banner as signal so hearts would not doubt.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xuanchen had frontier merit but was coerced to follow the rebels. At night he summoned followers to plan return to the state, spread word, and many agreed. He sent Zhang Gao to Chengxun to fix a date to kill rebel generals and surrender, raising a blue banner as signal.

sentences.zh: 承訓大喜，從之。

translations.literal: Chengxun was greatly pleased and agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Chengxun was greatly pleased and agreed.

sentences.zh: 九月，丁巳，張儒等飲酒於柳溪亭，玄稔使部將董厚等勒兵於亭西。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the dingsi day, Zhang Ru and the others drank at Liuxi pavilion; Xuanchen had his officer Dong Hou and others marshal troops west of the pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingsi, Zhang Ru drank at Liuxi pavilion. Xuanchen had Dong Hou marshal troops west of the pavilion.

sentences.zh: 玄稔先躍馬而前，大呼曰：「龐勳已梟首於僕射寨中，此輩何得尚存！」

translations.literal: Xuanchen first leaped on horseback forward and shouted loudly, "Pang Xun's head is already hung in the vice director's stockade—how can you lot still exist!"
translations.idiomatic: Xuanchen leaped forward on horseback and shouted, "Pang Xun's head is already hung in the vice director's stockade—how can you still exist!"

sentences.zh: 士卒競進，遂斬張儒等數十人，城中大擾，玄稔諭以歸國之計，及暮而定。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers vied to advance and then beheaded Zhang Ru and several dozen others; great turmoil arose in the city; Xuanchen explained the plan to return to the state, and by evening it was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers vied forward and beheaded Zhang Ru and dozens of others. Turmoil arose in the city. Xuanchen explained the plan to return to the state; by evening it was settled.

sentences.zh: 戊午，開門出降。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day they opened the gates and came out to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu they opened the gates and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 玄稔見承訓，肉袒膝行，涕泣謝罪。

translations.literal: Xuanchen saw Chengxun bare to the waist and advancing on his knees, weeping and begging pardon.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanchen saw Chengxun bare to the waist, advancing on his knees, weeping and begging pardon.

sentences.zh: 承訓慰勞，即宣敕，拜御史中丞，賜遺甚厚。

translations.literal: Chengxun consoled him, immediately proclaimed the edict, appointed him vice censor-in-chief, and bestowed gifts very generously.
translations.idiomatic: Chengxun consoled him, proclaimed the edict, appointed him vice censor-in-chief, and bestowed generous gifts.

sentences.zh: 玄稔復進言：「今舉城歸國，四遠未知，請詐為城陷，引眾趨苻離及徐州，賊黨不疑，可盡擒也！」

translations.literal: Xuanchen further advanced and said, "Now the whole city returns to the state but the four quarters do not yet know; please feign that the city has fallen and lead the crowd toward Fuli and Xu Prefecture—the rebel partisans will not doubt and can all be captured!
translations.idiomatic: Xuanchen said further, "The whole city returns but the four quarters do not know. Feign that the city has fallen and lead troops toward Fuli and Xu—the rebel partisans will not doubt and can all be taken!

sentences.zh: 承訓許之。

translations.literal: Chengxun agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Chengxun agreed.

sentences.zh: 宿州舊兵三萬，承訓益以數百騎，皆賞勞而遣之。

translations.literal: Suzhou's old troops numbered thirty thousand; Chengxun added several hundred horsemen, all rewarded and sent off.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou's old troops numbered thirty thousand. Chengxun added several hundred horsemen, rewarded them, and sent them off.

sentences.zh: 玄稔復入城，暮發平安火如常日。

translations.literal: Xuanchen re-entered the city and at dusk sent the usual peace fires.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanchen re-entered the city and at dusk sent the usual peace fires.

sentences.zh: 己未向晨，玄稔積薪數千束，縱火焚之，如城陷軍潰之狀，直趨苻離，苻離納之，既入，斬其守將，號令城中，皆聽命，收其兵，復得萬人，北趨徐州。

translations.literal: Before dawn on the jiwei day Xuanchen piled several thousand bundles of firewood, set them afire as if the city had fallen and the army had broken, and rushed straight to Fuli; Fuli admitted them; once inside they beheaded the garrison commander, ordered the city, all obeyed, gathered the troops, and got another ten thousand men, then marched north toward Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Before dawn on jiwei Xuanchen piled firewood, set fire as if the city had fallen, and rushed to Fuli. Fuli admitted them; they beheaded the commander, gathered ten thousand men, and marched north on Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 龐舉直、許佶聞之，嬰城拒守。

translations.literal: Pang Juzhi and Xu Ji heard of it and closed the city to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Juzhi and Xu Ji heard and closed the city to resist.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，玄稔至彭城，引兵圍之，按兵未攻，先諭城上人曰：「朝廷唯誅逆黨，不傷良人，汝曹奈何為賊城守？

translations.literal: On the xinyou day Xuanchen reached Pengcheng, led troops to besiege it, held troops without attacking, and first announced to those on the walls, "The court only punishes rebels and does not harm good people—why do you serve the rebels and hold the city?
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Xuanchen reached Pengcheng, besieged it without attacking, and announced to the walls, "The court only punishes rebels, not good people—why hold the city for rebels?

sentences.zh: 若尚狐疑，須臾之間，同為魚肉矣！」

translations.literal: If you still hesitate, in a moment you will all be fish on the chopping block!
translations.idiomatic: If you still hesitate, in a moment you will all be meat on the block!

sentences.zh: 於是守城者稍稍棄甲投兵而下。

translations.literal: Thereupon the city defenders one after another cast off armor and threw down weapons and came down.
translations.idiomatic: The defenders one after another cast off armor, threw down weapons, and came down.

sentences.zh: 崔彥曾故吏路審中開門納官軍，龐舉直、許佶帥其黨保子城，日昃，賊黨自北門出，玄稔遣兵追之，斬舉直、佶首，餘黨多赴水死，悉捕戍桂州者親族，斬之，死者數千人，徐州遂平。。

translations.literal: Cui Yanzeng's former clerk Lu Shenzhong opened the gate and admitted the government army; Pang Juzhi and Xu Ji led their partisans to hold the inner citadel; at sundown rebel partisans exited the north gate; Xuanchen sent troops to pursue, beheaded Juzhi and Ji's heads; the rest mostly died in the water; all kin of those garrisoned at Guizhou were seized and beheaded; several thousand died; Xu Prefecture was then pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzeng's former clerk Lu Shenzhong opened the gate. Juzhi and Xu Ji held the inner citadel. At sundown rebels exited the north gate; Xuanchen pursued and beheaded them. Kin of Guizhou garrisoners were beheaded; several thousand died. Xu Prefecture was pacified.

sentences.zh: 龐勳將兵二萬自石山西出，所過焚掠無遺。

translations.literal: Pang Xun led twenty thousand troops out from west of Shishan; wherever they passed they burned and plundered without leaving anything.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Xun led twenty thousand troops out west of Shishan, burning and plundering wherever they passed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，承訓始知之，引步騎八萬西擊之，使朱邪赤心將數千騎為前鋒。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day Chengxun at last learned of it and led eighty thousand infantry and cavalry west to strike them, making Zhuye Chixin lead several thousand horsemen as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Chengxun learned of it and led eighty thousand infantry and cavalry west, with Zhuye Chixin and several thousand horsemen as vanguard.

sentences.zh: 勳襲宋州，陷其南城。

translations.literal: Xun raided Songzhou and took its south city.
translations.idiomatic: Xun raided Songzhou and took its south city.

sentences.zh: 刺史鄭處沖守其北城，賊知有備，捨去，渡汴，南掠亳州，沙陀追及之。

translations.literal: Prefect Zheng Chuchong held the north city; the rebels, knowing there were preparations, abandoned it and crossed the Bian, raided south into Bozhou, and the Shatuo pursued and caught up.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Zheng Chuchong held the north city. The rebels, knowing he was prepared, abandoned it, crossed the Bian, raided Bozhou, and the Shatuo caught up.

sentences.zh: 勳引兵循渙水而東，將歸彭城，為沙陀所逼，不暇飲食，至蘄，將濟水，李袞發橋，勒兵拒之。

translations.literal: Xun led troops along the Huan River east intending to return to Pengcheng; pressed by the Shatuo he had no leisure to eat or drink; reaching Qi he was about to cross the river when Li Gun burned the bridge and marshaled troops to resist him.
translations.idiomatic: Xun led troops east along the Huan toward Pengcheng. Pressed by the Shatuo he could not eat. At Qi he was about to cross when Li Gun burned the bridge and resisted.

sentences.zh: 賊惶惑不知所之，至縣西，官軍大集，縱擊，殺賊近萬人，餘皆溺死，降者才及千人，勳亦死而人莫之識，數日，乃獲其屍。

translations.literal: The rebels were panicked and knew not where to go; reaching west of the county the government army massed and unleashed an attack, killing nearly ten thousand rebels; the rest all drowned; those who surrendered amounted to only a thousand men; Xun also died and no one recognized him; after several days his corpse was at last obtained.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels panicked. West of the county the government army massed and attacked, killing nearly ten thousand; the rest drowned. Only a thousand surrendered. Xun died unrecognized; after several days his corpse was found.

sentences.zh: 賊宿遷等諸寨皆殺其守將而降。

translations.literal: Rebel stockades at Suqian and elsewhere all killed their garrison commanders and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel stockades at Suqian and elsewhere killed their commanders and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 宋威亦取蕭縣，吳迥獨守濠州不下。。

translations.literal: Song Wei also took Xiao County; Wu Tong alone held Haozhou and would not come down.
translations.idiomatic: Song Wei also took Xiao County. Wu Tong alone held Haozhou and would not submit.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，以張玄稔為右驍衛大將軍、御史大夫。。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Zhang Xuanchen was made right Martial Valor great general and grand censor.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, Zhang Xuanchen was made right Martial Valor great general and grand censor.

sentences.zh: 馬舉攻濠州，自夏及冬不克，城中糧盡，殺人而食之，守軍深塹重圍以守之。

translations.literal: Ma Ju attacked Haozhou from summer through winter without taking it; grain in the city was exhausted and they killed people to eat them; the garrison dug deep trenches and heavy encirclement to hold it.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Ju attacked Haozhou from summer through winter without success. Grain was exhausted; they killed people to eat. The garrison dug deep trenches and held under heavy siege.

sentences.zh: 辛丑夜，吳迥突圍走，舉勒兵追之，殺獲殆盡，迥死於招義。。

translations.literal: On the xinchou night Wu Tong broke out of the encirclement and fled; Ju marshaled troops to pursue and killed and captured nearly all; Tong died at Zhaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou night Wu Tong broke out and fled. Ju pursued and killed or captured nearly all. Tong died at Zhaoyi.

sentences.zh: 以康承訓為河東節度使、同平章事，以杜慆為義成節度使。

translations.literal: Kang Chengxun was made Hedong military commissioner and Associate Grand Councilor; Du Tao was made Yicheng military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Chengxun was made Hedong military commissioner and Associate Grand Councilor. Du Tao was made Yicheng military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 上嘉朱邪赤心之功，置大同軍於雲州，以赤心為節度使，召見，留為左金吾上將軍，賜姓名李國昌，賞賚甚厚。

translations.literal: The emperor praised Zhuye Chixin's achievement, established the Datong Army at Yun Prefecture with Chixin as military commissioner, summoned him, kept him as left Golden Crow upper general, bestowed the surname Li and name Guochang, and rewarded him very generously.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Zhuye Chixin, established the Datong Army at Yun with him as commissioner, summoned him, kept him as left Golden Crow upper general, bestowed the surname Li and name Guochang, and rewarded him generously.

sentences.zh: 以辛讜為亳州刺史。

translations.literal: Xin Tan was made Bozhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Tan was made Bozhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 讜在泗州，犯圍出迎兵糧，往返凡十二。

translations.literal: At Sizhou Tan had broken through the siege twelve times to meet troops and grain going in and out.
translations.idiomatic: At Sizhou Tan had broken through the siege twelve times to meet troops and grain.

sentences.zh: 及除亳州，上表言：「臣之功，非杜慆不能成也。」

translations.literal: When appointed to Bozhou he submitted a memorial stating, "Your servant's achievement could not have been accomplished without Du Tao."
translations.idiomatic: When appointed to Bozhou he memorialized, "My achievement could not have been accomplished without Du Tao."

sentences.zh: 賜和州刺史崔雍自盡，家屬流康州，兄弟五人皆遠貶。。

translations.literal: He granted Hezhou prefect Cui Yong suicide; his family was exiled to Kang Prefecture; five brothers were all exiled far.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yong, prefect of Hezhou, was granted suicide; his family was exiled to Kang Prefecture; five brothers were all exiled far.

sentences.zh: 上荒宴，不親庶政，委任路巖。

translations.literal: The emperor was dissolute in feasts and did not personally handle ordinary government affairs, entrusting power to Lu Yan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was dissolute in feasts and did not handle government affairs, entrusting power to Lu Yan.

sentences.zh: 巖奢靡，頗通賂遺，左右用事。

translations.literal: Yan was extravagant and quite accepted bribes; his close attendants held power.
translations.idiomatic: Yan was extravagant and accepted bribes; his close attendants held power.

sentences.zh: 至德令陳蟠叟因上書召對，言：「請破邊咸一家，可贍軍二年。」

translations.literal: Zhide magistrate Chen Pansou took advantage of a memorial summons to audience and said, "I ask to confiscate the whole household of Bian Xian—then the army can be supplied for two years.
translations.idiomatic: Zhide magistrate Chen Pansou said at audience, "Confiscate the whole household of Bian Xian and the army can be supplied two years.

sentences.zh: 上問：「咸為誰？」

translations.literal: The emperor asked, "Who is Xian?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked, "Who is Xian?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「路巖親吏。」

translations.literal: He answered, "Lu Yan's close clerk."
translations.idiomatic: He answered, "Lu Yan's close clerk."

sentences.zh: 上怒，流蟠叟於愛州，自是無敢言者。。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry and exiled Pansou to Ai Prefecture; thereafter none dared speak.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was angry and exiled Pansou to Ai Prefecture. Thereafter none dared speak.

sentences.zh: 初，南詔遣使者楊酋慶來謝釋董成之囚，定邊節度使李師望欲激怒南詔以求功，遂殺酋慶。

translations.literal: Earlier Nanzhao had sent envoy Yang Qiouqing to thank them for releasing Dong Cheng from prison; Dingbian military commissioner Li Shiwang wished to provoke Nanzhao to seek merit and therefore killed Qiouqing.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Nanzhao had sent envoy Yang Qiouqing to thank them for releasing Dong Cheng. Dingbian commissioner Li Shiwang wished to provoke Nanzhao for merit and killed Qiouqing.

sentences.zh: 西川大將恨師望分裂巡屬，陰遣人致意南詔，使入寇。

translations.literal: Great generals of Xichuan resented Shiwang for splitting their patrol jurisdictions and secretly sent men to signal Nanzhao to invade.
translations.idiomatic: Xichuan generals resented Shiwang for splitting their jurisdictions and secretly signaled Nanzhao to invade.

sentences.zh: 師望貪殘，聚私貨以百萬計，戍卒怨怒，欲生食之，師望以計免。

translations.literal: Shiwang was greedy and cruel, amassed private goods to the count of a million, and garrison soldiers resented and raged, wishing to eat him alive; Shiwang escaped by stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: Shiwang was greedy and cruel, amassed private wealth to a million, and garrison soldiers wished to eat him alive. He escaped by stratagem.

sentences.zh: 朝廷征還，以太府少卿竇滂代之。

translations.literal: The court recalled him and replaced him with grand treasury vice minister Dou Pang.
translations.idiomatic: The court recalled him and replaced him with grand treasury vice minister Dou Pang.

sentences.zh: 滂貪殘又甚於師望，故蠻寇未至，而定邊固已困矣。

translations.literal: Pang was greedy and cruel even more than Shiwang; thus before the barbarian raiders arrived Dingbian was already in distress.
translations.idiomatic: Pang was greedier and crueler than Shiwang; before the barbarians arrived Dingbian was already in distress.

sentences.zh: 是月，南詔驃信酋龍傾國入寇，引數萬眾擊董舂烏部，破之。

translations.literal: That month Nanzhao chieftain Qiulong Qingguo invaded, leading tens of thousands to strike the Dongchunwu tribe and defeating it.
translations.idiomatic: That month Nanzhao chieftain Qiulong Qingguo invaded with tens of thousands, struck the Dongchunwu tribe, and defeated it.

sentences.zh: 十一月，蠻進寇巂州，定邊都頭安再榮守清溪關，蠻攻之，再榮退屯大渡河北，與之隔水相射九日八夜。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the barbarians advanced to raid Xi Prefecture; Dingbian chief commander An Zairong held Qingxi Pass; the barbarians attacked it; Zairong withdrew to encamp north of the Dadu River and shot at one another across the water for nine days and eight nights.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month barbarians raided Xi Prefecture. Dingbian chief An Zairong held Qingxi Pass; barbarians attacked; Zairong withdrew north of the Dadu and shot across the water nine days and eight nights.

sentences.zh: 蠻密分軍伐木開道，逾雪坡，奄至沐源川。

translations.literal: The barbarians secretly divided troops to cut timber and open a road, crossed the snow slope, and suddenly reached Muyuan River.
translations.idiomatic: Barbarians secretly cut timber and opened a road, crossed the snow slope, and suddenly reached Muyuan River.

sentences.zh: 滂遣兗海將黃卓帥五百人拒之，舉軍覆沒。

translations.literal: Pang sent Yanhai general Huang Zhuo with five hundred men to resist them; the whole army was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Pang sent Yanhai general Huang Zhuo with five hundred men to resist; the whole army was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 十二月，丁酉，蠻衣兗海之衣，詐為敗卒，至江岸呼船，已濟，眾乃覺之，遂陷犍為，縱兵焚掠陵、榮二州之境。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the dingyou day, the barbarians wore Yanhai clothing, pretended to be defeated soldiers, reached the riverbank and called for boats; once across the crowd at last discovered it; they then took Qianwei and unleashed troops to burn and plunder the territories of Ling and Rong prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingyou, barbarians wore Yanhai clothing, pretended to be defeated soldiers, called for boats at the riverbank, crossed, and took Qianwei, burning and plundering Ling and Rong.

sentences.zh: 後數日，蠻軍大集於陵雲寺，與嘉州對岸。

translations.literal: Several days later barbarian troops massed greatly at Lingyun Temple, facing Jia Prefecture across the river.
translations.idiomatic: Several days later barbarian troops massed at Lingyun Temple, facing Jia Prefecture across the river.

sentences.zh: 刺史楊忞與定邊監軍張允瓊勒兵拒之。

translations.literal: Prefect Yang Min and Dingbian army supervisor Zhang Yunqiong marshaled troops to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Yang Min and Dingbian supervisor Zhang Yunqiong marshaled troops to resist.

sentences.zh: 蠻潛遣奇兵自東津濟，夾擊官軍，殺忠武都將顏慶師，餘眾皆潰，忞、允瓊脫身走。

translations.literal: The barbarians secretly sent crack troops across from the east ford, attacked the government army from both flanks, killed Loyalty and Martial chief general Yan Qingshi, and the rest all broke; Min and Yunqiong escaped with their bodies.
translations.idiomatic: Barbarians secretly crossed from the east ford, flanked the government army, killed Yan Qingshi, chief general of Loyalty and Martial, and the rest broke. Min and Yunqiong escaped.

sentences.zh: 壬子，陷嘉州。

translations.literal: On the renzi day they took Jia Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi they took Jia Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 慶師，慶復之弟也。。

translations.literal: Qingshi was Qingsi's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Qingshi was Qingsi's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 竇滂自將兵拒蠻於大渡河，驃信詐遣清平官數人詣滂約和，滂與語未畢，蠻乘船筏爭渡，忠武、徐宿兩軍結陳抗之。

translations.literal: Dou Pang personally led troops to resist the barbarians at the Dadu River; the chieftain pretended to send several Qingping officials to Pang to treat for peace; before Pang had finished speaking the barbarians took boats and rafts and vied to cross; the Loyalty and Martial and Xu-Su armies formed ranks to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Pang personally resisted barbarians at the Dadu. The chieftain pretended to send Qingping officials to treat for peace. Before Pang finished speaking barbarians crossed in boats. Loyalty and Martial and Xu-Su armies formed ranks to resist.

sentences.zh: 滂懼，自經於帳中。

translations.literal: Pang was afraid and hanged himself in the tent.
translations.idiomatic: Pang was afraid and hanged himself in the tent.

sentences.zh: 徐州將苗全緒解之，曰：「都統何至於是！」

translations.literal: Xu general Miao Quanxu cut him down and said, "Why should the overall commander come to this!"
translations.idiomatic: Xu general Miao Quanxu cut him down and said, "Why should the commander come to this!"

sentences.zh: 全緒與安再榮及忠武將勒兵出戰，滂遂單騎宵遁。

translations.literal: Quanxu and An Zairong and the Loyalty and Martial general marshaled troops and went out to fight; Pang then fled alone on horseback by night.
translations.idiomatic: Quanxu, Zairong, and the Loyalty and Martial general marched out to fight. Pang fled alone by night on horseback.

sentences.zh: 三將謀曰：「今眾寡不敵，明旦復戰，吾屬盡矣。

translations.literal: The three generals consulted and said, "Now our numbers cannot match the enemy; if we fight again tomorrow we are all finished.
translations.idiomatic: The three generals said, "We cannot match the enemy. If we fight tomorrow we are all finished.

sentences.zh: 不若乘夜攻之，使之驚亂，然後解去。」

translations.literal: Better to take advantage of night to attack them, throw them into alarm and disorder, and then withdraw."
translations.idiomatic: Better to attack by night, throw them into disorder, and withdraw."

sentences.zh: 於是夜入蠻軍，弓弩亂髮，蠻大驚，三將乃全軍引去。

translations.literal: Thereupon they entered the barbarian army by night; bows and crossbows shot wildly; the barbarians were greatly alarmed; the three generals then led the whole army away intact.
translations.idiomatic: They entered the barbarian camp by night; bows shot wildly; barbarians were alarmed; the three generals withdrew intact.

sentences.zh: 蠻進陷黎、雅，民竄匿山谷，敗軍所在焚掠。

translations.literal: The barbarians advanced and took Li and Ya; the people fled and hid in mountain valleys; defeated troops everywhere burned and plundered.
translations.idiomatic: Barbarians took Li and Ya. People hid in valleys. Defeated troops burned and plundered everywhere.

sentences.zh: 滂奔導江。

translations.literal: Pang fled to Daojiang.
translations.idiomatic: Pang fled to Daojiang.

sentences.zh: 邛州軍資儲偫皆散於亂兵之手，蠻至，城已空，通行無礙矣。

translations.literal: Qiong Prefecture's military stores and reserves were all scattered in the hands of disorderly troops; when the barbarians arrived the city was already empty and passage was unobstructed.
translations.idiomatic: Qiong's stores were scattered among disorderly troops. When barbarians arrived the city was empty and passage unobstructed.

sentences.zh: 詔左神武將軍顏慶復將兵赴援。。

translations.literal: The court ordered left Divine Martial general Yan Qingsi to lead troops to go to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered left Divine Martial general Yan Qingsi to lead troops to the rescue.
